entries.en: But Silver Pixel's still hangin' in there.
All right, V. Tell me what's going on. For real.
entries.ro: Bine, V. Spune-mi ce se întâmplă. Pe bune.

entries.en: Sounds like a preem place for a date.
entries.ro: Pare un loc beton pentru o întâlnire.

entries.en: Managed to shut the whole thing down.
"Bushido X – Fade to Black." Must be a classic by now.
entries.ro: „Bushido X – Fade to Black.” Deja trebuie să fie clasic.

entries.en: Some crew takin' you along as bait?
entries.ro: Vreo gașcă te ia drept momeală?

entries.en: Where's Johnny? Couldn't make it after all?
entries.ro: Unde e Johnny? Până la urmă nu a putut veni?

entries.en: Drive-ins went out of style a century ago.
entries.ro: Drive-in-urile au ieșit din modă acum un secol.

entries.en: Can't stop us, won't stop us. We asked you out on a date.
entries.ro: Nu ne oprește nimeni. Te-am invitat la o întâlnire.
Ha, Johnny Silverhand făcând pe altruistul.

entries.en: Silver Pixel Cloud your favorite place?
entries.ro: Silver Pixel Cloud e locul tău preferat?

entries.en: OK. Looks like I found the projector.
entries.ro: OK. Cred că am găsit proiectorul.

entries.en: Once, probably. Haven't been there in ages.
entries.ro: Odată, probabil. N-am mai fost de secole.

entries.en: All right. Do your thing, I'll watch.
entries.ro: Bine. Fă-ți treaba, eu mă uit.

entries.en: [Take pills] You kids have fun now.
Exactly where I was supposed to take her. Fifty odd years ago.
entries.ro: Exact unde trebuia s-o duc. Acum vreo cincizeci de ani.

entries.en: Just, this time don't go roamin' around town. And no tattoos. And don't clean out my cred.
entries.ro: Doar că, de data asta, nu mai umbla prin oraș. Și fără tatuaje. Și nu-mi goli reputația.

entries.en: Maybe you'll find some charm third time around.
entries.ro: Poate a treia oară o să găsești ceva farmec.

entries.en: That Johnny's "wow" or yours? When's he gonna show?
entries.ro: «Wow»-ul e al lui Johnny sau al tău? Când apare și el?

entries.en: See you keep him on a short leash.
entries.ro: Văd că-l ții bine din scurt.
Deci nu a fost ideea lui.

entries.en: Which is why I suggested Johnny take me there. A million years ago.
entries.ro: De aceea i-am sugerat lui Johnny să mă ducă acolo. Acum un milion de ani.

entries.en: His idea of a romantic night out was blowing up Arasaka HQ.
entries.ro: Ideea lui de seară romantică era să arunce în aer sediul central Arasaka.

entries.en: Johnny doesn't do a thing without an ulterior motive.
entries.ro: Johnny nu face nimic fără un motiv ascuns.

entries.en: So what's in play this time?
entries.ro: Ce miză avem de data asta?

entries.en: He really does wanna spend some time with you.
entries.en_m: He really does wanna spend some time with ya.
entries.ro: Chiar vrea să petreacă timp cu tine.

entries.en: No hooks, no lines, no sinkers.
Apparently, you're a positive influence on him.
entries.ro: Se pare că ești o influență bună pentru el.

entries.en: OK, gotta be the pass, this.
entries.ro: OK, ăsta cred că e primul pas.

entries.en: Guess we really are going to the movies.
Closed? Really has been a while, I guess.
entries.ro: Închis? Trebuie că a trecut ceva timp.

entries.en: Technically, it's open – been here before.
entries.ro: Tehnic, e deschis – am mai fost aici.

entries.en: Know a way in. Practically have the place all to ourselves.
entries.en_m: I know a way in. Practically have the place all to ourselves.
entries.ro: Știu o cale de intrare. Practic, avem locul numai pentru noi.

entries.en: You wouldn't happen to know how to get it up an' running?
entries.ro: Nu cumva știi cum să-l pornești?

entries.en: Try and get the projector started – I'll get us some seats.
entries.ro: Pornește proiectorul, că eu iau locuri.

entries.en: Right, let's go check the projector.
Look at that – last played "Bushido X"! Perfect.
entries.ro: Uite! Ultimul film rulat a fost „Bushido X”! Perfect.

entries.en: Looks like a spurt of runny shit.
entries.ro: Pare un jet de rahat lichid.

entries.en: All right, V. Run along. I'll take it from here.
entries.ro: Ai treabă, V. De-aici mă descurc eu.

entries.en: V, we're at a drive-in. Movie's the last thing we care about.
entries.ro: V, suntem la drive-in. Filmul e ultimul lucru care ne pasă.

entries.en: Just want some background noise – a little blood, tits and gore, that sorta thing.
entries.ro: Vrem doar ceva de fundal – un pic de sânge, sâni și gore, d-alea.
Porsche-ul ăsta e al lui Johnny? Ahaha!

entries.en: That's what was in the container, the one Grayson was talking about.
entries.ro: Asta era în container, cel despre care vorbea Grayson.

entries.en: Hm, OK. Hehe, got a lotta memories in this car.
entries.ro: Hehe, am o grămadă de amintiri în mașina asta.
Acum nimic nu ne mai oprește.
